description: This file defines the PostgresSaver class, which manages checkpoint storage and retrieval in a PostgreSQL database, including methods for listing, getting, putting, and deleting checkpoints, as well as handling chat messages.

classes.name: PostgresSaver
classes.description: A class for saving and retrieving checkpoints in a PostgreSQL database, implementing memory methods and checkpoint management.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a table name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new DataSource based on configuration options.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates the checkpoints table if it does not exist, setting up the database schema.

methods.name: getTuple
methods.description: Retrieves a checkpoint tuple from the database based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists checkpoint tuples with optional limit and pagination.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores or updates a checkpoint and its metadata in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes checkpoints associated with a specific thread ID.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages associated with a session ID, optionally converting to base messages.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder method for adding chat messages (not implemented).

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages for a session ID by deleting them.
